"""Freeze fixed array-only endpoint reductions before quality is observed."""
import ast
from pathlib import Path
from train_directional_bank_trial import ref,save

repo=Path('/home/dllu/proj/demosaic');root=repo/'.cache/quality-20261107/V161-harmonic-context-v1'
snapshot=root/'protocol-document-v1.md';assert not snapshot.exists();snapshot.write_bytes((repo/'docs/harmonic-frequency-context.md').read_bytes())
mapping={'summarize-v160-final-v1.py':'summarize-v161-final-v1.py',
    'build-v160-tables-v1.py':'build-v161-tables-v1.py','paired-v160-regions-v2.py':'paired-v161-regions-v1.py',
    'quiet-dc-v160-final-v1.py':'quiet-dc-v161-final-v1.py','record-v160-viewing-v1.py':'record-v161-viewing-v1.py',
    'route-v160-final-v1.py':'route-v161-final-v1.py','compare-v160-retained-v1.py':'compare-v161-retained-v1.py'}
sources=[]
for old,new in mapping.items():
    p=repo/'.cache'/new;assert not p.exists()
    text=(repo/'.cache'/old).read_text()
    text=text.replace('V160-paired-response-v1','V161-harmonic-context-v1').replace('v160-paired-response','v161-harmonic-context')
    text=text.replace('ordinary','paired-control').replace('paired-response','harmonic-context')
    text=text.replace('Ordinary raw','Pair ctrl raw').replace('Ordinary EMA','Pair ctrl EMA')
    text=text.replace('Pair response raw','Harmonic raw').replace('Pair response EMA','Harmonic EMA')
    if old.startswith('paired'):
        text=text.replace('matched-arm comparison changes only paired-response weight0 versus1 on identical fresh data. Both differ from historical V159 in data;the ordinary arm is not an archive replay.',
            'matched-arm comparison adds6720 parameters and distant dyadic context at fixed V160 data/loss. Current paired control exactly reproduces V160;older comparisons also include other data/loss differences.')
        # The arm-name replacement above changes these words too;make scope explicit.
        start=text.index("    'scope':");end=text.index('\n',start)
        text=text[:start]+"    'scope':'Lower-is-better actual errors retain every case/worst increase. All four current endpoints versus parent plus two candidate/control contrasts. Current paired-control exactly replays V160;candidate adds context/capacity at fixed loss/data. CFA placements/reused recipes are related,not independent scenes or significance.'})"+text[end:]
    if old.startswith('record'):
        start=text.index("        'scope':");end=text.index('\n',start)
        text=text[:start]+"        'scope':'All four fixed V161 endpoints;candidate adds distant dyadic context/capacity at exact V160 paired data/loss. Five retained V156/V157/V158/V159/V160 ordinary columns share all observations. Original-detail viewing recorded only after images are seen. Both protected GFX scenes/windows/priors/JPEGs assessed;ISO100 references qualitative,not exactGT.'})"+text[end:]
    if old.startswith('route'):
        text=text.replace("cache-result-v2.json","CACHE_PLACEHOLDER")
        text=text.replace("cache=read(root/'CACHE_PLACEHOLDER');training=read(root/'train-result-v1.json')",
            "plan=read(root/'plan-v1.json');cache=read(plan['cache']['path']);training=read(root/'train-result-v1.json')")
        text=text.replace("ref(root/'CACHE_PLACEHOLDER')","plan['cache']")
        assert 'CACHE_PLACEHOLDER' not in text
    if old.startswith('compare'):
        needle="    'V159':(repo/'.cache/quality-20261107/V159-regional-dc-transition-v1','smooth-dc'),"
        assert needle in text
        text=text.replace(needle,needle+"\n    'V160 ordinary':(repo/'.cache/quality-20261107/V160-paired-response-v1','ordinary'),")
        text=text.replace('All four current endpoints compared with both retained endpoints of V156/V157/V158/V159. These older comparisons also change training data,not an isolated pair-loss estimate. Only current paired-control/harmonic-context isolates weight0 versus1.',
            'All four current endpoints compared with V156/V157/V158/V159 and V160 ordinary. Retained comparisons include architecture/loss/data differences;only current paired-control fixes V160 paired data/loss for the context/capacity comparison.')
    ast.parse(text);p.write_text(text);sources.append(ref(p))
save(root/'final-helper-preparation-v1.json',{'status':'fixed-reductions-prepared-before-quality','sources':sources,
    'protocol_snapshot':ref(snapshot),'source':dict(ref(Path(__file__)),text=Path(__file__).read_text()),
    'new_forwards':0,'new_noise_draws':0})
print('Prepared7 fixed reduction/table/viewing sources;not executed')
